facts.text: I am trying to get a gift for my coworker who is leaving soon.
I want ideas for a nice coffee mug or a gift card to a popular coffee shop for my coworker.
I like the idea of a personalized mug.
I am not sure how much I can afford for a customized mug.
I think I have spent around $500 in the past month on gifts for others.
I need to get a birthday card for my sister.
My sister's birthday is on the 15th of this month.
I already got my sister a beautiful silver necklace with a small pendant from the new jewelry store at the mall.
I am thinking of getting my sister a nice card and a bouquet of her favorite flowers, sunflowers.
I will write a heartfelt message expressing my love and appreciation for my sister.
I am all set with the gift and card for my sister's birthday.
I am back to my coworker's gift.
I am thinking of getting my coworker a funny mug with a quote about coffee or leaving a job.
